PHOTO FILE - UNIT 7 (raqamsiz bet, pdf 151). Qirqib olinadigan karta. Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 7'.

XAT QOG'OZI (rasmli bo'shliqlar):
'6th May ......'
'Dear Karen, I'm sorry I haven't written for so long, but as you can imagine, I've been very busy since we moved into our new house. It's a lovely house, but we still have a lot of work to do!'
'We 1) ...... ...... ...... (already/paint) [RASM: qizil bo'yoq bankasi va cho'tka] the walls and we 2) ...... ...... (hang) the [RASM: pushti pardali deraza] 3) ...... . We 4) ...... ...... (repair) the back door and we 5) ...... ...... ...... (also/lay) the carpets, but we 6) ...... ...... (not/buy) all the [RASM: ko'k divan, stol, stul] 7) ...... yet. We 8) ...... ...... (put up) shelves in the kitchen, too. Unfortunately, we 9) ...... ...... (not/tidy) the [RASM: begona o'tli bog'] 10) ...... yet, but we 11) ...... ...... (mend) the [RASM: yog'och panjara] 12) ...... .'
'I'm sure you'll love the house when you see it! We wanted to have a housewarming party, but at the moment everything is still in such a mess. I just hope it won't take too long to clear up the mess! Do come and visit us when you've got time. Love, Jill'

⚠ Bu 7-unitdagi Writing (Project) uchun shablon - present perfect (already/yet).

exercises.explanationUz:
XAT TARJIMASI (to'ldirilgan):

6-may
Aziz Karen,
Shuncha vaqt yozmaganim uchun
kechir, lekin tasavvur qilganingdek,
yangi uyga ko'chganimizdan beri juda
band bo'ldim. Bu chiroyli uy, lekin
hali ko'p ish qilishimiz kerak!

Biz devorlarni ALLAQAChON BO'YaDIK va
PARDALARNI OSDIK. Orqa eshikni
TA'MIRLADIK va GILAMLARNI HAM
TO'ShADIK, lekin hali barcha MEBELNI
SOTIB OLMADIK. Oshxonaga javonlar
ham O'RNATDIK. Afsuski, BOG'NI hali
TARTIBGA KELTIRMADIK, lekin
PANJARANI TUZATDIK.

Ishonchim komil, uyni ko'rganingda
yoqadi! Uy to'yi qilmoqchi edik, lekin
hozir hammasi hali tartibsiz. Umid
qilamanki, tartibga keltirish ko'p
vaqt olmaydi! Vaqting bo'lganda
albatta kel.
Muhabbat bilan, Jill


JAVOBLAR:
  1 have already painted
  2 have hung
  3 curtains
  4 have repaired
  5 have also laid
  6 haven't bought
  7 furniture
  8 have put up
  9 haven't tidied
  10 garden
  11 have mended
  12 fence

  ⚠ PRESENT PERFECT: have + V3.
  ⚠ 'already' - have va V3
  ORASIDA; 'yet' - gap OXIRIDA
  (inkorda).
  ⚠ hang → hung; lay → laid.


⚠ 'AS YOU CAN IMAGINE':

  = tasavvur qilganingdek.


⚠ 'TO MOVE INTO':

  = ko'chib kirmoq.


⚠ 'TO LAY CARPETS':

  = gilam to'shamoq.


⚠ 'TO PUT UP SHELVES':

  = javon o'rnatmoq.


⚠ 'A HOUSEWARMING PARTY':

  = uy to'yi (yangi uy bazmi).


⚠ 'IN SUCH A MESS':

  = shunday tartibsiz.


⚠ 'TO CLEAR UP':

  = tartibga keltirmoq.
